scope: Identify original ballroom celebration dressing gaps; no new art/model generation
audit_method: Registry-wide name review plus separate visual inspection of GEN-07 and GEN-20; previous one-at-a-time visual reviews of GEN-24/GEN-25 and their source panels. Not an exhaustive visual review of all45 boards.

new_design_gaps.name: Celebration chair
new_design_gaps.reason: Ordinary upright guest seating; existing throne, chaise and garden bench do not supply this compact party-chair variant.
new_design_gaps.design_direction: Rose upholstery, ivory frame, fine gold; compact source-compatible chair rather than another throne.

new_design_gaps.name: Rose-lotus teapot
new_design_gaps.reason: Tea-service hero; no dedicated teapot construction reference in audited boards/registry.
new_design_gaps.design_direction: Small ivory/rose ceramic body, restrained lotus shaping, gold rim; spout, handle and lid separable.

new_design_gaps.name: Teacup and saucer
new_design_gaps.reason: Human-scale place setting; no dedicated cup/saucer reference.
new_design_gaps.design_direction: One coordinated assembly with separate cup and saucer geometry; thin gold and rose/blue motif.

new_design_gaps.name: Milk jug
new_design_gaps.reason: Small pouring vessel for tea-service grouping; source wish bowl is a different object.
new_design_gaps.design_direction: Match teapot ceramic/glaze vocabulary; readable open lip and handle.

new_design_gaps.name: Lidded sugar bowl
new_design_gaps.reason: Tea-service table detail; no dedicated sugar-bowl reference.
new_design_gaps.design_direction: Small low vessel and removable lid; gold rim and modest star/lotus knob.

new_design_gaps.name: Dessert plate
new_design_gaps.reason: Birthday-cake place setting; cake stand is not a serving plate.
new_design_gaps.design_direction: Shallow human-scale ceramic plate with source rose/star border; distinct from large floor medallion.

new_design_gaps.name: Cake server
new_design_gaps.reason: Cake-display accessory; no dedicated hand-held server reference.
new_design_gaps.design_direction: Delicate gold/silver blade and ivory/rose handle; fully readable silhouette.

new_design_gaps.name: Serving tray
new_design_gaps.reason: Grouping cups/place settings; existing cake stand and marble side table do not provide a portable tray.
new_design_gaps.design_direction: Low-rim ivory/rose/gold tray; optional small handles, no source cake glued onto it.

new_design_gaps.name: Invitation/place-card holder
new_design_gaps.reason: Support existing invitation artwork upright on tables; guest-book/card art exists but a dedicated holder profile is missing.
new_design_gaps.design_direction: Small stable gold/ivory holder with removable card slot; reuse GEN-25-A10 invitation art.

new_design_gaps.name: Birthday memory display
new_design_gaps.reason: Optional framed portrait or birthday-memory insert to make the room personal; mirror is a different function.
new_design_gaps.design_direction: Reuse GEN-24-A03 frame/crest vocabulary when suitable; design a picture insert/backing/stand rather than another ornamental mirror.

existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.name: Loose seat/throw cushions
existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.evidence: Chaise source already shows cushions; GEN-20 also supplies cushion construction/embroidery.
existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.action: Isolate existing cushion shape/embroidery. Extra styles are optional, not a proven missing master.

existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.name: Table candles and candlesticks
existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.evidence: Visible on the original wish table.
existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.action: Extract visible parts; add another view only if shaft/base/back remains ambiguous. Do not create a new candle style by default.

existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.name: Curtain rod, finials, tiebacks and tassels
existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.evidence: Explicit detail panels in existing curtain source.
existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.action: Index/isolate existing detail parts and normalize span/mounts.

existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.name: Pearl strings, hanging loops and moon/star charms
existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.action: Use existing motifs; define repeat segment and end attachment lengths.

existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.name: Floral clusters and ribbon swags
existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.evidence: Existing floral arch/swag assembly and detailed cluster source.
existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.action: Reuse/isolate existing clusters, not another generic bouquet pack.

existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.name: Garland/banner hanging brackets
existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.evidence: An indexed garland hanging bracket and banner mounting design already exist.
existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.action: Compare mounting face/scale to interior support; generate a new adapter only if actual fit requires it.

existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.name: Table flower vase/bowl
existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.evidence: A flower vessel and star bowl already appear on the wish table.
existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.action: Isolate existing vessels; no new centerpiece-vase master yet.

existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.name: Rug, embroidered tablecloth and long runner motifs
existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.evidence: Rug border/corner and tablecloth embroidery/corner/tassel details exist.
existing_parts_needing_isolation_or_fit.action: Reuse source textile motifs; a long runner needs length/repeat/end planning, not an unrelated new floor or cloth design.

assembly_reference_gaps.name: Long textile and festoon repetition
assembly_reference_gaps.rule: Declare straight repeat length and terminal/corner treatment from existing border/pearl/swags; end phase and curves are not proven by source art.

assembly_reference_gaps.name: Curtain-to-window fitting
assembly_reference_gaps.rule: Original curtain label is3.2m high, while proposed lower ballroom opening is taller. Use deliberate partial-height dressing or reviewed extensions; do not blindly stretch trim, tassels or human-scale objects.

assembly_reference_gaps.name: Support/mount fitting
assembly_reference_gaps.rule: Confirm hanging points, hooks/brackets and load path on real walls/galleries. Existing mounts remain candidates until the attachment face fits.

assembly_reference_gaps.name: Celebration placement
assembly_reference_gaps.rule: Actual display/seating group placement is missing even where art exists. Keep arrival, paired stairs and central floor-star routes readable; fixture/view parity is unresolved.

generation_proposal.layout: One labelled sheet; independent illustration scales. Chair larger cell, nine small tabletop/display objects readable and separated.
generation_proposal.palette: rose/cherry upholstery and ceramic accents, ivory/cream surfaces, fine gold, restrained blue/lilac motif accents
generation_proposal.budget: Do not add an eleventh palace sheet slot beyond cap65. Reallocate an unproduced/superseded reservation when this sheet is scheduled. Global230 target unchanged.
